postInstallNotes:
## text-dynamic-reveal installed (no-op today)

This block is a placeholder. The `DynamicTextComponent` component and `TextUpdateSystem` that drive the typewriter effect currently ship inside `rendering-text`, which this block depends on, so installing it has no additional files.

**Usage of the reveal effect:**
```csharp
entity.Set(new DynamicTextComponent {
    TextContent = "Hello world",
    RevealingSpeed = 30f,        // characters per second
    RevealStartTime = 0f,         // set to GameState.Total when starting
    IsRevealed = false,
    VisibleCharacterCount = 0,
    // ... font, color, scale, etc.
});
```

`TextUpdateSystem` advances `VisibleCharacterCount` based on `(GameState.Total - RevealStartTime) * RevealingSpeed` and flips `IsRevealed = true` when complete.

When the static/dynamic split is performed inside `MonoDreams/System/Draw/`, this block will own the reveal portion and `rendering-text` will keep only the static path. Until then, this block is reserved.
